QuestInfo.name: The Temple Investigation 3
QuestInfo.0: The Trainees somehow lost their very faces and were locked away in the storage room. By this point, the Handsome Monk seems more suspicious than ever.
QuestInfo.1: Follow the Taotie as it leads you with its keen senses to where the monster's energy can be felt most strongly.
QuestInfo.2: With the Taotie's help, you traced the monster's aura to this location, but another locked door bars your progress.
